newsitem.title: USA: Delmarva closes offer to buy preferred stk.
newsitem.headline: Delmarva closes offer to buy preferred stk.

text.p: Delmarva Power & Light Co said Monday its August 21 offer to purchase preferred stock closed on Friday.
The utility said it is very pleased with the excellent response to its tender offers.
A preliminary count showed the following shares have been tendered:
-- 10,134 shares of the 3.70 percent preferred stock, representing 20.3 percent of those outstanding;
-- 20,126 shares of the 4 percent preferred stock, representing 50.3 percent of those outstanding;
-- 24,596 shares of the 4.20 percent preferred stock, representing 49.2 percent of those outstanding;
-- 21,540 shares of the 4.28 percent preferred stock, representing 43.1 percent of those outstanding;
-- 30,429 shares of the 4.56 percent preferred stock, representing 60.9 percent of those outstanding;
-- 31,477 shares of the 5 percent preferred stock, representing 39.3 percent of those outstanding;
-- 165,000 shares of the 6-3/4 percent preferred stock, representing 82.5 percent of those outstanding;
-- 1,283,500 shares of the 7-3/4 percent preferred stock, representing 80.2 percent of those outstanding; and
-- 9,650 shares of the adjustable rate preferred stock, series A, representing 6.0 percent of those outstanding.
